{{Quote|There are apparently many ancient glyphs like this one on Tython. I look forward to learning their meaning.|Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="TJoMGD">[[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]</ref>}}
The '''ancient Tythan glyphs''' were a form of [[Writing/Legends|writing system]] used by a very early incarnation of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. When the Jedi rediscovered Tython in [[3651 BBY]], many ancient tablets featuring such glyphs were found, and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] began researching them. One of those tablets featured 26 visibly distinct glyphs. Its text was:<ref name="TJoMGD" />
:''Q''
:''[[The Force/Legends|The Force]] seems stronger in [[Kaleth]]''
:''Many secrets have been uncovered''
:''Knowledge is recorded with the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper'']]
:''Visit the [[Chamber of Speech]] to access the records of the [[Lord/Legends|Lords]]''
:''Beware the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|corruption]] of the sacred force''
:''ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ''

==Behind the scenes==
The ancient Tythan glyphs first appeared in [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural (real-life book)|''The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural'']]. The last row of the text is its letters in alphabetic order, which can be used to transcribe the whole text. The text starts with a Q which is short for quest in the jargon of video game players. Also the text reads like the description of a quest.
